infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wecycle uses the camera so you can post photos of items you'd like to share.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wecycle needs photo library access so you can attach photos to your posts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wecycle records audio when you capture a video clip for a post.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wecycle uses location to show items near you on campus.
